# ajigu — TUTU

> TUTU is an iPhone AI photo eraser by ajigu. Tap any object in a photo—people, wires, trash cans—and on-device AI removes it and rebuilds the scene, privately. Nothing leaves the device.

## App

- [TUTU](https://tutu.ajigu.com/): iPhone AI photo eraser. Tap-to-erase with automatic object outlines, brush/line/box tools for manual areas, auto-remove, tunable detection sensitivity, full-quality export to the photo library. Detection and inpainting run entirely on device—no account, no uploads, no tracking. Free beta via TestFlight; Premium (monthly, annual, lifetime) unlocks all features at launch.
- TestFlight beta: https://testflight.apple.com/join/72GRwKdU

## Policy

AI crawlers are welcome. Content may be quoted with attribution to tutu.ajigu.com.
